purpose: Offline instrumented diagnosis, no QPS/Pareto or deployed-method claim

statistics.stream_order: WebVid then Yandex; each dataset n512 then n128; within-group shared row draws
statistics.ndc_intervals: NDC is descriptive; no extra significance family

tie_rules.single: max hits, min NDC, min real base ID
tie_rules.combination: max hits, min NDC, metadata column
tie_rules.A1: one GT10 hit below optimum; 0.1 per-query Recall tolerance, not a negligible quality margin

router_diagnostics.interpretation: Proxy-score approximation only; utility differences are reported separately.

float64_cosine_reference.note: Float64 cosine uses auxiliary normalization; rank differences are descriptive, not a search bug.
